content:
nina: Periodic access review spotted svc-ci-main@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com with roles/owner on project infra-staging. Likely overprivileged.

omar: Oof. Was that added by automation or manually?

deeps: Quick grep in policy history shows SetIamPolicy from infra-admins group on 2026-01-12. Might be a migration leftover.

nina: We need to follow least-priv flow: 1) collect evidence, 2) propose minimal role, 3) run canary in staging, 4) schedule production change with rollback plan.

omar: I'll pull the SetIamPolicy entry and recent admin actions made by that SA.

deeps: Use this query:```bash
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-ci-main@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com" AND protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "Create" OR "Delete")' --format=json --limit=200 > /tmp/svc-ci-admin-actions.json
```

ticket-bot: Ticket SEC-4332 created for svc-ci-main entitlement remediation. Owners assigned: nina, omar. Evidence location: gs://redwood-sec-evidence/SEC-4332/.

omar: Found a handful of infra changes last month (config updates, secrets write). Need to confirm which exact perms were used.

nina: If it wrote secrets, KMS access might be required. Check CMEK usage on secrets-manager and whether the SA had cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt.

deeps: KMS logs query:```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" OR resource.labels.project_id="infra-staging" protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-ci-main@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --limit=500 --format=json > /tmp/svc-ci-kms-uses.json
```

omar: KMS shows decrypts tied to secret-rotation job in staging only. No production decrypts. Good sign for canary.

nina: Proposal: create role roles/ci.runnerLimited with only the exact perms observed (secretManager.access, cloudkms.decrypt for a specific key, deployment.manager.run). Put it behind a short-lived binding and test for 24h in staging.

deeps: Drafted IAM policy snippet and PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-iam/pulls/612 - includes acceptance tests that assert least-priv on CI pipelines.

nina: Schedule for canary: tomorrow 03:00 UTC on infra-staging. Omar to run revoke script and monitor. Oncall to watch deploy pipeline and pager.

omar: I'll prepare revoke job and an automated post-check audit:```bash
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-ci-main@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com" AND timestamp>="2026-03-05T03:00:00Z"' --limit=200 --format=json > /tmp/post-revoke.json
```

deploy-bot: infra-deploy: latest build 9c2a passed. Will watch for failures after permission change.

oncall: I'll mute noise but will escalate if >2 pipeline failures in 15m or any secret access errors.

nina: Evidence bundle to include policy diffs, log extracts, KMS decrypt samples, and test run outputs. Keep in ticket SEC-4332. If rollback required, steps in PR description.

omar: After successful 24h canary we'll propose prod change and schedule in maintenance window. If any downstream consumers surface missing perms, we will fast-track exception or adjust role.

nina: Thanks. Keeping this thread as canonical. Ping here for status updates. :thumbsup:
